Implement an asynchronous FIFO with 2**LGFIFO entries of WIDTH bits.

i_wclk and i_rclk are independent clocks. Please take care of any clock-domain crossings between them. The resets are active-low.

Queue words across the write and read sides, in order. Storage must accept 2**LGFIFO writes before any read, and o_wr_full must be high only when that storage is occupied. A write while full must not change stored data. A read while empty must not change o_rd_data or drop a later word. While write reset is asserted, o_wr_full is low. Honor the selected write edge. OPT_REGISTER_READS selects additional output registering; neither setting bypasses destination-clock sampling.

Additional transfer latency and bubbles spanning multiple receiving-clock edges are permitted. OPT_REGISTER_READS selects an additional output holding register or a destination-clock sample; neither setting provides an asynchronous memory bypass.
